name: hold
_note: the top hand curled a little over the bump (still q_k4_down_0; Harry on v5: 'rather than being a little curled over the top of the bump'): LONG fingers lying together, fanned only a few degrees so the round tips stay their own, the curl GRADED from the index (~30° tip to knuckle) to the little finger (~70°) so the tips step in a diagonal and the lines between the fingers run long; the thumb tucked along the far side. Works with the hand placed palm DOWN onto the dome (hand_place --palm-down 0.55): with its palm normal pointing away from us a 3D curl only shortened the fingers. Tried: 70-85° ('a mitten'), 45-65° unplaced ('straight planks'), 65-85° placed ('a paw'); v7 drafts: together with thin lines ('a fused mitten'), fanned ±10° with ~90° on the little finger ('a claw', its lines broken into dashes). Picked side by side with the still (tools/hand_shapes.py, lessons 51-52)
